text:
Bitra, also known as Bitrā Par, is a coral atoll belonging to the Amindivi Subgroup of islands of the Union Territory of Lakshadweep in India.
It is 483 km (300 mi) west of the city of Kochi.
best_time: October to March (pleasant weather, ideal for heritage monuments, wildlife, and cultural walks)
